integrity: Analytic derivation and finite numerical corroboration are included. The numerical checker is not an independent proof or certification.
scientific_limitations: For independent area-uniform points in a unit-circumradius regular polygon. The quantitative O_T(delta^4) normalized remainder is uniform only at bounded rescaled deficits. The leading interior crossover follows by radial integration from a published boundary endpoint limit; complete finite-polygon point-distance distributions are known. The contribution concerns the first nonzero correction, a controlled uniform remainder, and its conditional interior geometry. Historical priority and independent mathematical validation remain open.
title: A two-term parity crossover for nearly diametral interior pairs in regular polygons
